api_tokens_intro: Bearer tokens for external apps hitting Persona's /api/* endpoints. Use the header Authorization: Bearer <token>. Persona stores only the SHA-256 hash — the raw value is shown exactly once below, right after you issue it.
api_tokens_enforce_on: Enforcement is ON. Every /api/* request must supply a valid bearer token. Requests without an Authorization header are rejected with HTTP 401.
api_tokens_enforce_off: Enforcement is OFF (default). Tokens are validated when supplied, but /api/* is still reachable without one. Set PERSONA_API_AUTH_REQUIRED=true in your .env to require a token on every API call.

api_tokens_scopes_help: Pick what this token may do. admin:bulk implies every write:*, and any write:* implies read — you don’t need to tick those manually. If you tick nothing, the token defaults to read.
api_tokens_usage_note: Scopes are enforced per-route via check_scope. Issue read-only tokens by default; add narrow write:* scopes only for the resources a client actually needs, and keep admin:bulk for trusted automation that mutates many records in one shot.
settings_backup_intro: Export every preference table (kv settings, redaction rules, auto-collections, OCR skip-list, phrase tags, saved searches, note templates, app capture overrides, webhooks, quiet hours) as a single JSON file you can re-import on another machine. Screenshots, OCR text, audit logs, and the encrypted vault are not included — this is preferences-only.
settings_backup_download_note: Streams a persona-settings-YYYY-MM-DD.json attachment. Webhook signing secrets are stripped from the export — you will need to regenerate them on the destination machine.
settings_backup_replace_warn_body: Choosing Replace below truncates every preference table on this machine before inserting the rows from the uploaded file. Local tweaks that aren't in the backup will be lost. Pick Merge if you're unsure — it keeps existing rows and only fills in what's missing.
settings_backup_merge_desc: INSERT OR IGNORE — keeps existing rows, only fills in what's missing. Safe to re-run.
settings_backup_replace_desc: Truncate each table first, then insert. Destructive — overwrites local preferences.
settings_backup_import_url_note: Fetches a backup JSON from a remote http(s) URL and applies it in merge mode (additive — existing rows are kept). Handy for syncing preferences across machines: point each instance at the same private gist or internal share, then re-trigger the import after edits. Capped at 1 MiB with a 5 second timeout.
vault_intro: Store API keys, webhook secrets and SMTP passwords encrypted with a master password you re-enter on every read. Each row uses its own salt + Fernet token; rotating one secret never touches the others. Persona never stores the master password — lose it and the rows are unrecoverable.

settings_cat_member_ai_desc: Your model, the assistant's character, chat modes and skills.
settings_cat_member_memory_desc: What the assistant remembers about you and how it connects.
settings_cat_member_profile_desc: What the AI knows about you — name, context, preferences.
friends_subtitle: Find people by exact e-mail or name, add them — and start writing.
friends_search_hint: E-mail must match in full, names need 3+ characters. Anyone who turned discovery off is not findable at all.
friends_search_empty: Nobody found. Check the address — it has to match exactly.
friends_remove_confirm: Remove from friends? The history stays, but you won't be able to write.
friends_empty: Empty so far. Find someone with the search above.
friends_discoverable: I can be found by search
friends_discoverable_hint: Turn it off and nobody can find you — not by name, not by exact e-mail.
friends_net_error: Network is not responding, try again
dm_ai_mode_off_hint: Nothing happens. This is the default in every conversation.
dm_ai_mode_draft_hint: The AI prepares a reply and shows it to YOU only. Nothing is sent automatically.
dm_ai_mode_auto_hint: The AI writes as you. The other person sees an «✨ answered by AI» label.
dm_ai_ack: I understand the AI will write on my behalf and that the other person will see it.
dm_ai_style_placeholder: keep it short; do not agree to meetings
dm_ai_llm_missing: No model connected — the AI cannot reply. Add your own key in the model settings.
dm_ai_honesty_hint: Every AI reply is labelled «✨ answered by AI» for both sides. The AI never replies to another AI, never schedules meetings and never makes promises.
dm_ai_where_title: Where the AI replies for me
dm_ai_where_empty: Nowhere — the AI replies in no conversation.
dm_ai_off_everywhere: Turn the AI off in all conversations
dm_ai_off_everywhere_hint: Sets every conversation to off and withdraws consent to reply on your behalf.
social_notif_subtitle: What to send where about friends and direct messages. Browser only by default.
social_notif_email_cooldown_hint: Email: at most one message per conversation every
social_notif_tg_not_connected: Not connected — Telegram notifications will not arrive.
social_notif_tg_step1: Send /newbot to @BotFather and get your bot token.
social_notif_tg_step2: Open your bot and press Start (/start) — otherwise it cannot message you.
social_notif_tg_step3: Find your chat id (e.g. via @userinfobot) and paste it here.
social_notif_tg_clear: Unlink Telegram (erase token and chat id)
social_notif_tg_privacy: The token is yours only, never returned by any endpoint and never logged. Leaving the field empty erases nothing.
